posts.title: A lot of what we called talent was just scarce execution
posts.description: Anyone who has used the latest frontier models seriously comes away feeling two things at once: amazed, and completely, hopelessly lost. And honestly, for good reason. For decades, we built our identities around intelligence, hard work, deep knowledge, reliability, getting hard things done, and delivering under pressure. We celebrated people who could out-think, out-work, and out-execute everyone

posts.title: Our causes will define who we are
posts.description: What we care about will define who we are We might be the first generation in history where the majority of people will identify more with their causes than their work. Thanks to AI Historically, economic activity has concentrated on filling gaps in the market - typically areas where there is deficiency in some offering. Entrepreneurs identify sections and areas where needs are not being satisfied

posts.title: LLM providers should be regulated like telecom
posts.description: LLM providers should be regulated like telecom A huge amount of VC and global attention is focussed on building large language models and companies like OpenAI are all the rage. There is a feeling that these companies will usher in a new economic revolution. I buy that.
